title: Earning Rates and Qualifying Spend: Marlowe Rewards Tier Table
content:
Marlowe Rewards points are earned on qualifying spend at a base rate, and the base points are multiplied by the multiplier of the member's tier.

## Rates by tier

| Tier | Base points per USD of qualifying spend | Tier points multiplier | Points per USD once the multiplier is applied |
|---|---|---|---|
| Marlowe Rewards Member | 1 | 1.00 | 1 |
| Marlowe Rewards Silver | 1 | 1.25 | 1.25 |
| Marlowe Rewards Gold | 1 | 1.50 | 1.50 |
| Marlowe Rewards Platinum | 1 | 2.00 | 2 |
| Marlowe Rewards Icon | 1 | 2.50 | 2.50 |
| Marlowe Rewards Atelier | 1 | 3.00 | 3 |

The last column is the base rate multiplied by the tier points multiplier.

## Terms common to every tier

| Term | Every tier |
|---|---|
| Rounding of fractional points on a single posting | To the nearest whole point, a half point rounding up |
| Pending period | 30 calendar days after the posting date before earned points become available for conversion |
| Shipping fees count as qualifying spend | No |
| Sales tax counts as qualifying spend | No |
| Buying a gift card counts as qualifying spend | No |
| The part of an order paid with Marlowe Rewards Notes counts as qualifying spend | No |
| The part of an order paid with gift cards, Return Store Credit or Goodwill Credit counts as qualifying spend | Yes |

## Points of judgement

- **Tender.** Merchandise paid with a Marlowe & Finch Gift Card, Return Store Credit or Goodwill Credit earns like merchandise paid by card; merchandise paid with a Marlowe Rewards Note does not earn.
- **Rounding.** Rounding happens on a single posting, never point by point. A hypothetical posting worth 106.5 points rounds to 107; one worth 106.49 rounds to 106.
- **Pending.** Points posted on a hypothetical 1 April become available 30 calendar days later, on 1 May.
